title: test asserts less than the symbol promises
question: Find the tests that cover this symbol: search src/tests for its name, and for the scenario or headless-session entry points that would run it. If nothing covers it, the verdict is n/a with na_clause "no test covers this symbol" and the searches as evidence. Otherwise: do those tests assert its actual contract — the values, ordering, bounds and failure modes its name and signature promise — or only that it runs, returns truthy, or does not throw?
fail_requires: the test file and case, as path:line
the part of the contract left unasserted
an input that would pass the test while the behaviour is wrong
not_a_finding: a smoke test that is explicitly labelled as one and sits alongside real assertions
a contract that is asserted in a headless scenario rather than a unit test

title: untested behaviour a cheap test would pin
question: Search src/tests for this symbol’s name and for any scenario that would run it, and say which searches you ran. If something covers it, the verdict is n/a with na_clause "a test covers this symbol". Otherwise: does this exported symbol have a branch, bound or ordering guarantee that no test covers and that a single cheap unit test would pin?
fail_requires: a proposed test name (the test itself is written on escalation, not here)
the searches over src/tests that found nothing
not_a_finding: a symbol whose behaviour is only meaningful over real ticks — that escalates to a headless scenario, not a unit test
a pure re-export or one-line delegation
a symbol already covered by a headless scenario — that is n/a, not a fail
